eyebrow: The slow-exfiltration example, as a hunt
code:
// No correlation rule ever fires — every transfer stays
// just under its threshold. A hunt asks a different question:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| summarize TotalBytesOut = sum(BytesSent) by AccountName
| where TotalBytesOut > 500000000
| order by TotalBytesOut desc
caption: Actively looking for sustained, low-volume outbound transfer no rule's threshold ever caught.
